{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Your Honors, Supreme Chancellor Valorum. Just two weeks ago the senate met in special session to vote on a motion introduced by Supreme Chancellor Valorum, calling for a tax to be levied on all shipping and other mercantile activities in what were formerly known as the free trade zones of the outlying systems.|Bail Antilles to the Judiciary council|<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>}}
The '''Judiciary council''' was made up of twelve [[Judge/Legends|judges]], led by a [[Chief Justice]], who heard the [[Supreme Court inquiry against Finis Valorum|inquiry]] of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] in the [[Supreme Court/Legends|Supreme Court]]. The inquiry was brought by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]], who chaired the [[Internal Activities Committee/Legends|Internal Activities Commitee]],<ref name="CoD" /> in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref>
